final_response: Replied to the client’s urgent outage email.

args.body:
Hi,

We’re very sorry for the disruption and understand this is urgent. We’ve received your report that the integration has been down for two hours and are investigating immediately.

We’ll keep you updated as soon as we have more information. If possible, please send any recent error messages or changes made before the outage so we can expedite troubleshooting.

Thanks for your patience,
[Your Name]
args.title: Re: Urgent outage complaint
